name: rcoi
description: RCOI: Royal Courts of India - an online card bluffing game for 2-5 players

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @rcoi/server" "npm run dev -w @rcoi/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rcoi/client && npm run build -w @rcoi/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
